summary: First full test of WIV bilingual NGO site. Backend (9/9) and frontend (all critical flows) tests passed. Stripe donation flow redirects to checkout.stripe.com; contact form persists and returns email_sent=false; PayPal returns 503 as expected; config flags correct; language switch, nav dropdown, hero CTAs, program email/whatsapp buttons, footer, custom-amount, validation-toast, and contact success toast all working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 427 lines — acceptable but nearing the split-threshold; consider modularising (payments.py, contact.py, config.py) if it grows further.
Stripe checkout error handler re-raises HTTPException(500) — consider returning 502 for upstream failures for clearer semantics (minor).
PayPal endpoints correctly gate on PAYPAL_ENABLED and return 503; email path degrades gracefully with email_sent=false. Good.
test_credentials: None required. Stripe test mode is live (sk_test_...).
seed_data_creation: Created donation records (TEST_Donor / test_donor@example.com) and contact_messages (TEST_User) via test API calls. Not cleaned up — negligible test data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PayPal (paypal_enabled=false) and Resend email (email_enabled=false) are intentionally not configured — do not treat 503 on /api/paypal/create-order or email_sent=false as bugs. Stripe uses claimable sandbox keys; checkout URLs redirect to checkout.stripe.com. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_wiv_backend.py can be re-run with pytest.
